name: Studio Stars Restaurant
description: The premier dining destination at Universal Studios Japan — Studio Stars Restaurant is a large and elegant buffet restaurant in the heart of USJ serving a wide range of Japanese and international dishes including Osaka specialities, pasta, grilled meats and seasonal Japanese cuisine. The most popular and highly regarded full-service dining experience at the park.

items.name: Osaka Takoyaki
items.description: Classic Osaka-style octopus balls with bonito flakes and sauce

items.name: Teppanyaki Beef Set
items.description: Grilled wagyu beef with rice, miso soup and pickles

items.name: Pasta Marinara
items.description: Spaghetti with fresh tomato and basil sauce

name: The Dragon's Pearl Restaurant
description: A beautifully themed Chinese restaurant in the Wizarding World zone at USJ — serving authentic Chinese and Asian fusion dishes in an atmospheric setting inspired by the magical world of Harry Potter and wizarding cuisine. One of the most uniquely themed dining experiences at Universal Studios Japan.

items.name: Dim Sum Set
items.description: Selection of steamed dim sum with dipping sauces

items.name: Peking Duck Wrap
items.description: Crispy Peking duck with pancakes and hoisin sauce

items.name: Butterbeer
items.description: The iconic Wizarding World Butterbeer — cold or frozen

items.name: Pumpkin Juice
items.description: Refreshing pumpkin spice juice from the Wizarding World

name: Saido Restaurant
description: An authentic Japanese restaurant at Universal Studios Japan serving traditional Osaka-style cuisine including ramen, udon, donburi rice bowls and Japanese set meals. One of the most popular and authentic Japanese dining options at USJ for guests wanting genuine local food between rides.

items.name: Tonkotsu Ramen
items.description: Rich Osaka-style pork bone broth ramen with chashu

items.name: Karaage Don
items.description: Crispy Japanese fried chicken on rice with egg and sauce

items.name: Udon Set
items.description: Thick udon noodles in dashi broth with tempura

items.name: Takoyaki Set
items.description: Classic Osaka takoyaki with all toppings

name: Amity Landing Restaurant
description: A charming New England-style seafood restaurant in the Amity Village zone at USJ — serving fish and chips, seafood chowder, clam baskets and classic American coastal food in an atmospheric waterfront setting inspired by the movie Jaws. The most atmospheric quick-service dining location at Universal Studios Japan.

items.name: Fish and Chips
items.description: Beer-battered fish with thick chips and tartar sauce

items.name: New England Clam Chowder
items.description: Classic creamy clam chowder in a sourdough bread bowl

items.name: Lobster Roll
items.description: Fresh lobster in a buttered brioche roll

items.name: Root Beer Float
items.description: Classic American root beer with vanilla ice cream
